summary: E9 observation: memory.py NDJSON entries use actor+value schema; adapters.py context reader expects metadata.role+content. Field mismatch silently injects empty user messages — chat history is invisible to the LLM.
evidence: helen_os_scaffold/helen_os/memory.py:77-84 — NDJSON entry: {event_id, key, value, actor, status, timestamp}
helen_os_scaffold/helen_os/adapters.py:21 — role = h.get('metadata', {}).get('role') → None (no metadata key in NDJSON)
helen_os_scaffold/helen_os/adapters.py:24-25 — elif role not in ['user','system'] → role='user' (all entries fall here)
helen_os_scaffold/helen_os/helen.py:53,57 — history = memory.get_history(); context = [system_msg] + history — full mismatch-schema list passed to adapter
helen_os_scaffold/helen_os/helen.py:90-99 — add_fact(key='user_input', value=..., actor='user') and add_fact(key='helen_response', value=..., actor='helen') — correct keys never mapped
mechanism: adapters.OllamaAdapter/OpenAIAdapter.generate() maps role from h['metadata']['role'] and content from h['content']. NDJSON entries have neither field. Result: every history entry → {role:'user', content:''} silent empty message. LLM has no access to prior conversation context despite it being stored.
proposed_tweak: Two options — (A) map at read time in get_history(): return entries with metadata.role from actor and content from value; (B) map at inject time in helen.py:57 via list comprehension: [{'metadata':{'role':e['actor']},'content':e['value']} for e in history]. Option A is single-source fix (one method, closes all call sites). Proposal only — no write.
metric: Before fix: adapter sees content='' for all history entries. After fix: adapter sees content=user_message for actor='user' entries and content=her_response for actor='helen' entries. Observable: LLM response incorporates prior turn context (e.g. second message 'what did I just say?' returns correct answer).
keep_rule: KEEP if: adapter receives non-empty content for helen/user history entries; helen chat response demonstrates continuity across turns. REJECT if: mapping introduces sovereign fields (avoid injecting event_id/status into LLM prompt).
next: Implement Option A: add tail param AND field mapping to get_history(). Test with two-turn chat; verify second response references first turn.
risk_flags: Option A changes get_history() return schema — verify helen_talk.py:373 and server.py:59 slices still work on new format
actor='helen' must map to role='assistant' for Ollama/OpenAI API compliance (adapters.py:22 already handles this — helen→assistant mapping present)
